_comment: Which Canvas section meets in which block. Nothing reads this yet; it is here so a later feature can answer "4th period is this Canvas section" without you retyping it. To use it, copy this file to section-map.json, delete the "sample": true line, and fill in your own blocks.
_comment_sections: Each key is a block id from your bell schedule file. course_id is the Canvas course id as text, and section_name is what that section is called in Canvas. Leave out any block you do not teach.
